about_s01_b01p: We organise and support, in Romanian, official programmes of the Monroe Institute®: residential programmes, workshops, free exercises and the Dolphin Energy Club. The programmes are led by accredited trainers of the Institute. Their audio technology is Hemi-Sync®.
about_s02_b01l: We speak of exploration and experience, not promised results.
about_s02_b02l: We do not present Hemi-Sync® as therapy and do not replace a doctor or a psychologist.
about_s02_b03l: We ask for no belief: what the method proposes is checked in your own experience.
about_s02_b04l: We do not publish testimonials with promises of healing and quote no figures without a source.
about_s02_h: How do we work, and what do we not do?
about_s03_b01p: The Monroe Institute is a non-profit research and education organisation in Virginia, USA, founded in 1971 by Robert Monroe. Its stated mission is the guided exploration of expanded consciousness, without doctrine. The full story is in the [history of Hemi-Sync](page:history).
about_s03_b02p: The marks (Hemi-Sync®, Monroe Institute® and the names of the programmes) belong to their owners; see [marks and licences](page:trademarks).

club_s01_b01p: The Dolphin Energy Club (DEC) was founded in 1991 within The Monroe Institute. The Romanian Dolphin Energy Club brings together listeners who practise the DEC exercise together, a Hemi-Sync® recording that combines verbal guidance with sound patterns and uses the dolphin as a symbol, associated with communication and intelligence.
club_s01_b02p: It is a listening practice with an intention of support toward another person. It is not therapy and does not replace diagnosis, medical or psychological treatment or other specialist care.
club_s01_h: What is the Dolphin Energy Club?
club_s02_b01l: The coordinator receives a request, directly from the person concerned or with their explicit consent.
club_s02_b02l: Members receive by e-mail the name, locality and reason for which support is asked.
club_s02_b03l: At least ten members use the DEC exercise, at least three times over a period of two weeks, with their intention directed to that person.
club_s02_b04p: The support offered through DEC is free for the person who asks. The experiences reported over time are personal accounts, not proof.
club_s02_h: How does a request for support run?
club_s03_b01p: A person may ask for themselves or for someone else, but only with the explicit consent of the person it is for. Without consent, the request is not passed on.
club_s04_b01p: You send a membership request. As a member you receive two Hemi-Sync® DEC exercises: one with the basic methods and a guided meditation for your own well-being, another for the support offered to those who ask. Membership means you use DEC only for people who have asked for support and take part in the requests passed on by the coordinator.
club_s04_b02p: The club does not use accounts on the site: registration and requests go through the coordinator. The annual membership fee covers coordination and running costs; the published amount appears below. To hear the introductory exercise, listen to [Intro to DEC](page:exercises).

faq_g01_a01: An audio technology created by Robert Monroe that uses, among other things, binaural beats: each ear receives a slightly different frequency and the brain perceives the difference as a third rhythm. It guides attention toward relaxation, clarity and exploration. Details: [how it works](page:technology).
faq_g01_a02: With the free exercises, on headphones, in a quiet place. Start with the introduction to the technology. The steps are in [Getting started](page:start). If you want a group setting, follow with a workshop or [Gateway Voyage®](prog:gateway-voyage).
faq_g01_a03: Each ear has to receive its own tone, unmixed. On speakers the two tones combine in the air and the binaural effect does not appear at all. The tones are low, so on laptop speakers they are barely audible.
faq_g01_a04: No. The Monroe method asks for no doctrine, religion or view of reality. The only idea offered for consideration is that you might be more than your physical body, with no obligation to accept it. The conclusions are yours.
faq_g01_a05: No, for the foundation programmes. Every participant is led step by step. Some advanced programmes have mandatory preliminary programmes, stated for each. If you already meditate, read [Hemi-Sync and meditation](page:meditation).

focus_h1: The Focus levels: a map of states of consciousness
focus_lead: Focus 10, 12, 15 and 21 are names given to states you explore gradually, guided by sound. Here is each one, as listeners and the Monroe programmes describe it.
focus_s01_b01p: The Focus levels are a shared language. The Monroe Institute gave numbers to states of consciousness that participants had explored, so that they could talk about them without loading them with a doctrine. “Focus 10” says where you are in an experience, not how “far” you have got.
focus_s01_b02p: The numbers do not mean “better” or “more advanced”. A quiet Focus 10 can be exactly what you need on a hard day, and a higher level is not a prize. The image the Monroe model uses is a radio: the same consciousness, tuned to different frequencies.
focus_s01_b03k: The descriptions on this page are accounts of listeners’ experience and of the Monroe programmes, not statements about reality.
focus_s01_h: What are the Focus levels, and why are they not rungs?
focus_s02_b01p: Focus 10 is described as a state in which the body is deeply relaxed, close to asleep, while the mind stays awake and attentive. It is the first level explored in Gateway Voyage® and, in many ways, the base of the others.
focus_s02_b02p: How it feels, as listeners put it: heavy or outline-less limbs, slow breathing, thoughts that come and go without carrying you away, sometimes brief images as at the edge of sleep. The most common difficulty is not “getting there” but not falling fully asleep, and that is learned by repetition, without strain.
focus_s02_b03p: For home, the [free exercises](page:exercises) and the [article on the Focus levels](art:nivelurile-focus-pe-intelees) are a good start.
focus_s02_h: What is Focus 10, “mind awake, body asleep”?
focus_s03_b01p: Focus 11 is a level of connection. The Monroe model describes it as a channel linking the mental, physical and emotional planes of attention. It opens at the start of Human Plus® exercises, where the listener formulates an intention, and it is associated with the SyncCreation® programme.
focus_s03_h: What is Focus 11, the access channel?
focus_s04_b01p: In Focus 12 the body stays asleep while attention widens beyond what you usually notice: sounds, sensations, ideas and intuitions seem to have more room. The Monroe programmes call it a “state of expanded awareness” and use it for intention, creativity and self-knowledge.
focus_s04_b02p: Listeners often tell of a quiet clarity, of solutions that appear “by themselves” to a problem you had stopped thinking about, or of a peace with no reason. Others describe only good relaxation. Both are valid experiences, and neither is guaranteed.
focus_s05_b01p: Focus 15 is described as a state in which consciousness moves away from the body’s signals and linear time seems to stop mattering for the experience. The programmes that explore it, among them Gateway Voyage® and Timeline®, use it to look differently at the past, the future and the course of one’s own life.
focus_s05_b02p: The words “no time” describe a sensation, not a theory about the physics of time. Many listeners feel it as a deep stillness with a lot of space in it.
focus_s05_h: What is Focus 15, the “no time” state?
focus_s06_b01p: Focus 21 is the level the Monroe model places at the edge of the space-time continuum: the body is in very deep relaxation while the mind stays awake and able to explore. It is explored in Gateway Voyage®, in Guidelines® and in Lifeline®.
focus_s06_b02p: What lies “beyond”, the Monroe model speaks of in images: bridges, thresholds, other systems of reality. We read them as metaphors of experience, not as claims you must believe. What you do is listen, notice, and draw your own conclusions.
focus_s06_b03k: The official name and text for Focus 21 on this site still await approval; until then we use the careful wording above.
focus_s06_h: What is Focus 21, and what is said about it?
focus_s06_o: At the edge of the core model
focus_s07_b01p: The model continues with levels numbered up to 27, explored in more advanced programmes such as Lifeline® and Explorare 27®. They usually require preliminary programmes. Their description appears here only in the approved wording, again as accounts of experience.
focus_s08_b01p: Not by an effort of will. In a Hemi-Sync® exercise the voice leads and the sound supports. You usually take your first steps in Focus 10, then go further only when you are ready. The residential programmes are built in this order: [Gateway Voyage®](prog:gateway-voyage) is the starting point for most of the advanced ones.
focus_s08_b02p: More on the order of the programmes is on the [programmes](page:programmes) page, and the terms you do not know are in the [glossary](page:glossary).
focus_s08_h: How do you move from one level to another?
focus_s09_b01p: Nothing has gone wrong. Experiences differ a great deal: some are visual, others only a sensation, an idea or a stillness. Do not turn the exercise into a test and do not compare it with what others describe. Notice what appears, let it go, and return gently to the voice.

gloss_h1: Hemi-Sync® glossary: the terms of the Monroe method
gloss_lead: Sixteen terms you will hear in exercises, at programmes and on this site, each in a few lines, without jargon.
gloss_s01_b01p: The name of the audio technology created by Robert Monroe, from “hemispheric synchronisation”. It combines binaural beats, sound patterns, voice and music. See [how it works](page:technology).
gloss_s02_b01p: The rhythm you perceive when each ear hears, in headphones, a slightly different tone. If one ear hears 100 Hz and the other 104 Hz, you perceive a 4 Hz pulse that is in neither sound.
gloss_s03_b01p: The idea that the activity of the two cerebral hemispheres can tend to come into agreement, following the perceived rhythm. It is how the method describes its aim, not a fact proven for everyone in every condition.
gloss_s04_b01p: A number given to a state of consciousness explored in the Monroe method. It is not a rung to climb but a marker of experience. See [all the levels](page:focus).
gloss_s05_b01p: “Mind awake, body asleep”: deep relaxation of the body with full attention. The first level you explore at Gateway Voyage®.
gloss_s06_b01p: Expanded awareness: the body stays asleep while attention widens beyond what you usually notice.
gloss_s07_b01p: The “no time” state: a deep stillness in which linear time seems to matter less and less to the experience.
gloss_s08_b01p: The level placed, in the Monroe model, at the edge of the space-time continuum: very deep bodily relaxation, an awake mind. Its official description on this site awaits approval.
gloss_s09_b01p: A family of exercises in the Monroe method that start from Focus 11 and work with intention: you formulate what you want to explore or change, and hold it in attention during the exercise.
gloss_s10_b01p: The Monroe Institute’s fundamental six-day residential programme, with 5–6 exercises a day. See the [programme page](prog:gateway-voyage).
gloss_s11_b01p: The Hemi-Sync® audio series for individual study at home, organised in “waves” (Wave I, II, III…). It is not a residential programme and should not be confused with Gateway Voyage®.
gloss_s12_b01p: The evolution of the Institute’s audio technologies, built on the principles of Hemi-Sync® with a wider range of sound techniques.
gloss_s13_b01p: The Dolphin Energy Club: a community of listeners who use a dedicated Hemi-Sync® exercise together, with an intention of support. It is complementary and does not replace medical care. See the [club](page:club).
gloss_s13_h: What is the Dolphin Energy Club (DEC)?
gloss_s14_b01p: A kind of experience in which a person describes perceiving themselves apart from the physical body. It occurs spontaneously in some people. The programmes explore it as an experience, without guaranteeing it and without presenting it as proven fact.
gloss_s15_b01p: Knowing, while you dream, that you are dreaming. The Lucid Dreaming® programme combines dream-work methods, Monroe audio and practices for keeping awareness in the dream. See the [programme](prog:lucid-dreaming).
gloss_s16_b01p: The time afterwards: a pause, notes, a conversation. An exercise does not end when you take off the headphones but when you understand it enough to place it in your life. At the programmes, integration has dedicated hours.
gloss_s16_h: What does “integration” mean after an exercise?

hist_h1: The history of Hemi-Sync and The Monroe Institute
hist_img_caption: Archive image from the old page about The Monroe Institute.
hist_lead: A radio man, a curiosity about sleep and sound, an unexpected experience in 1958, and a technology patented in 1975. This is how Hemi-Sync® and The Monroe Institute came to be.
hist_s01_b01p: Robert Allan Monroe was born on 30 October 1915 and died in 1995, aged 79. He worked in radio, television and audio production, which matters for the story: a man who knew how a sound is built and what it can do to the attention of the person listening.
hist_s01_b02p: Described by those who tell his life as a practical, grounded businessman, he was not looking for a religion. He was looking, rather, for an answer to a simple question about sleep: why do we spend a third of our lives in a state we understand so little?
hist_s02_b01p: In the 1950s Monroe began experiments with sound patterns and the state of consciousness of volunteers, himself among them. The Institute’s accounts say his interest was first practical: if one could learn something during sleep, what would the sound have to be like?
hist_s02_b02p: In 1958, at 43, he had the first of those spontaneous experiences he later called “out of the body”. He was frightened, consulted doctors, kept a journal. Out of that journal came his first book, “Journeys Out of the Body” (1971).
hist_s02_b03p: This is the story as the Institute tells it. We read it as a personal account, interesting precisely for its candour, not as proof of what lies “beyond”.
hist_s02_h: How did it begin: sleep, sound, and 1958?
hist_s03_b01p: In 1971, with the publication of the book, Monroe founded The Monroe Institute, a non-profit research and education organisation based in Virginia, in the United States. Over time he moved to a property in the mountains and worked with people from psychology, medicine, sound engineering and other fields who wanted to study his method.
hist_s03_b02p: The Institute’s stated mission today is to help people create more meaningful and joyful lives through the guided exploration of expanded consciousness. Its methodology follows no doctrine, religion or social position. The only idea it offers for consideration is this: it might be possible that you are more than your physical body.
hist_s03_b03p: For the mission and how the programmes work today, read the [About](page:about) page and the [frequently asked questions](page:faq).
hist_s03_h: How did The Monroe Institute come about?
hist_s04_b01p: US patent 3,884,218, entitled “Method of inducing and maintaining various stages of sleep in the human being”, was filed on 30 September 1970 and granted on 20 May 1975, with Robert A. Monroe as inventor. Its main claim describes a repeating, soothing sound modulated with a waveform resembling a sleep EEG.
hist_s04_b02p: “Hemi-Sync®” comes from “hemispheric synchronisation”. It is the name of the audio technology that grew around these ideas: binaural beats, but also more complex sound patterns, voice and music. The Hemi-Sync® mark belongs to Interstate Industries, Inc., and Monroe® and Monroe Institute® are marks of the Institute.
hist_s04_b03p: How the technology works today is explained on the [Hemi-Sync® technology](page:technology) page.
hist_s04_h: What did Monroe patent in 1975, and what does the name Hemi-Sync® mean?
hist_s05_b01p: Beyond research, the Institute built programmes. Gateway Voyage® is the six-day residential programme, the “heart” of the Monroe programmes, with a history of over 50 years. Gateway Experience® is the home-study audio series, in “waves” (Wave I Discovery, Wave II Threshold, Wave III Freedom and onwards).
hist_s05_b02p: On this site you can take [Gateway Voyage®](prog:gateway-voyage) in Romanian, at Plaiul Foii, led by accredited trainers, and you can start free with the [Hemi-Sync® exercises](page:exercises). The Gateway Experience® series is available as a product at hemi-sync.ro.
hist_s05_h: How did Gateway Voyage® and Gateway Experience® come to exist?
hist_s06_b01l: 1839: Heinrich Wilhelm Dove describes binaural beats.
hist_s06_b03l: The 1950s: experiments with sound and states of consciousness.
hist_s06_b04l: 1958: the first spontaneous experience he calls “out of the body”.
hist_s06_b06l: 1971: “Journeys Out of the Body” appears and The Monroe Institute is founded.
hist_s06_h: What are the milestones at a glance?
hist_s07_b01p: The dates above can be checked: the birth, the books, the patent, the founding of the Institute. Interpretations are something else. That Monroe’s experiences point to something about the nature of consciousness is a hypothesis the Institute explores, and independent research has not established it.
hist_s07_b02p: We offer you the same attitude the method does: curiosity, not belief. Listen, notice, write things down, talk with people you trust.
hist_s07_h: How should we read this story with a clear mind?

med_lead: If you already meditate, you may wonder whether Hemi-Sync® would add something or get in the way of your practice. The short answer: they are friends, not rivals, but they are not the same thing.
med_s01_b01p: Not quite. Hemi-Sync® is an audio technology. The exercises built on it are usually guided meditations: a voice leads you and the sound in the background supports the state. Meditation, in the broad sense, is a practice of attention that can be done without any sound at all.
med_s01_b02p: In short, Hemi-Sync® can be a way of meditating, but meditation does not need Hemi-Sync®. The Monroe method asks for no doctrine and can coexist with any tradition or practice you follow.
med_s01_h: Is Hemi-Sync® a form of meditation?
med_s02_b01l: Attention: in both you learn to notice what appears without fighting it.
med_s02_b02l: Breath and posture: a comfortable position, slow breathing, a relaxed body.
med_s02_b03l: Regularity: effects (whatever they are) are noticed over time, not in a single session.
med_s02_b04l: Honesty: neither asks you to believe something, but to observe.
med_s02_h: What do they have in common?
med_s03_b01p: In silent meditation, the only support is your attention. In a Hemi-Sync® exercise you also have a voice, a purpose-built sound background and, at the residential programmes, a group setting and a trainer. For some people this makes entering stillness easier; for others it is too much structure.
med_s03_b02p: The Monroe method also uses a map of its own: the [Focus levels](page:focus), a language for the states explored. It is not a map of every contemplative tradition but of this method.
med_s04_b01p: Yes, and many practitioners use it as a complement. The Monroe programmes are integrative: they introduce their own tools, and you can keep yours. What is recommended is to approach them with a beginner’s mind and to set comparisons with what you know aside for the length of the exercise.
med_s04_h: Can I use Hemi-Sync® if I have meditated for years?
med_s05_b01l: Ten minutes of silent meditation in the morning; a Hemi-Sync® exercise on headphones in the evening.
med_s05_b02l: As a warm-up: the Hemi-Sync® exercise, then, after taking the headphones off, a few minutes of silence.
med_s05_b03l: Alternatively: on hard days, guided; on clear days, in silence.
med_s05_b04p: There is no recipe. Keep a notebook and see what is useful to you, in your life.
med_s05_h: How can you combine them in an ordinary day?
med_s06_b01p: The same as in ordinary meditation: notice them and return to the anchor. Here the anchor is the voice and the breath. Many thoughts do not mean failure, only that you have begun to hear them. More in [Getting started](page:start).
med_s06_h: What do I do about thoughts that will not stop?
med_s07_b01p: Meditation in general has a rich scientific literature, while studies of binaural beats are fewer and more mixed. We make no promises here about calm, sleep or concentration. We describe experiences, and if you want to judge for yourself, begin with the [free exercises](page:exercises).
med_s07_b02p: Meditation and Hemi-Sync® do not replace therapy or treatment. If you are going through a hard time, speak with a doctor or a psychologist.
med_s07_h: What is known about the effects of meditation with sound?

med_seo_title: Hemi-Sync® and Meditation: Similarities, Differences, Combining
pgv_s01_b01p: Gateway Voyage® is the Monroe Institute’s fundamental six-day residential programme, offered for over 50 years. It is a series of Hemi-Sync® exercises, partly verbally guided, that lead you gradually toward ever more relaxed and expanded states of awareness.
pgv_s01_b02p: It is the “starting point” for most of the advanced programmes: here the method’s main tools and the first Focus levels are introduced. It requires no prior meditation experience.
pgv_s02_b01p: In a day you generally listen to 5–6 Hemi-Sync® exercises: some verbally guided, others with more room for personal exploration. Between them come application sessions, group discussions, review, meals, free time and rest.
pgv_s02_b02p: You also receive information about the Monroe Institute’s research and demonstrations of how Hemi-Sync® can be seen in brainwave patterns. Whether you tell the group what you experience is your choice.
pgv_s02_h: What does a day at Gateway Voyage® look like?
pgv_s03_b01p: The programme explores the Focus levels 10, 12, 15 and 21, in that order and at each participant’s pace. They are described below and in depth on the [Focus levels](page:focus) page. They are not rungs to climb but markers of your experience.
pgv_s03_h: Which Focus levels do you explore?
pgv_s04_b01p: The out-of-body experience (OBE) and its methods of exploration are part of the programme but are only one of its directions. The appearance of a conscious OBE during or after the programme cannot be guaranteed. Exercises, information and a setting are offered that may facilitate it; they do not promise it.
pgv_s05_b01p: The residential programme takes place at Plaiul Foii, in Braşov county, with a view of the Piatra Craiului mountains. Facilitator: Ritta Nicoară, a psychologist and Monroe Institute residential and Outreach trainer. The language is Romanian; dates, price and places are in the calendar.
pgv_s05_b02p: To prepare, listen to the [free exercises](page:exercises), read the [history of Hemi-Sync](page:history) and the [frequently asked questions](page:faq).
pgv_s05_h: Where does it take place, and who facilitates?
pgv_seo_desc: Gateway Voyage®: what you explore in six days, what a day looks like, the Focus 10, 12, 15 and 21 levels, who facilitates and where. The foundation Monroe programme.
pgv_seo_title: Gateway Voyage®: The Six-Day Residential Monroe Programme
pld_s01_b01p: A six-day residential intensive on lucid dreaming: knowing, while you dream, that you are dreaming, and staying present in the dream. It combines modern dream-work methods, audio exercises with Monroe Sound Science technology devoted to sleep and the borderland between waking and sleep, and practices for keeping awareness during the dream.
pld_s01_h: What is the Lucid Dreaming® programme?
pld_s02_b02l: To become aware while dreaming and to interact with the dream’s content.
pld_s02_b03l: To look from another angle at fears and beliefs that limit you.
pld_s02_b04p: Lucid dreaming can be learned but is not promised: some reach it quickly, others take longer. The programme offers tools and a setting, not a guarantee.
pld_s02_h: What do you learn, and what is not promised?
pld_s03_b01p: The programme is led by two international Monroe Institute trainers, Allyn Evans (USA) and Luigi Sciambarella (UK), and is held entirely in English. It is open to participants from Romania and other countries and requires no prior experience. It takes place at Plaiul Foii, Braşov county.
pld_s03_b02p: If the terminology interests you, see the [glossary](page:glossary) (lucid dreaming, OBE). If you want to begin more gently, listen to the [free exercises](page:exercises).
pld_s03_h: Who leads it, in what language, and who can take part?
pld_seo_desc: Lucid Dreaming®: six days on lucid dreaming, with practical techniques and Monroe Sound Science audio. In English, with no preliminary programme.
pld_seo_title: Lucid Dreaming®: A Six-Day Monroe Intensive on Lucid Dreams
progs_lead: Residential programmes and workshops built on Hemi-Sync® technology, with accredited trainers. Here is what exists, in what order it is taken, and how to choose.
progs_s01_b02p: [Gateway Voyage®](prog:gateway-voyage): the fundamental six-day residential programme, with the first Focus levels and the method’s main tools.
progs_s01_b04l: Guidelines®: communication with clearer inner guidance, through higher levels of consciousness.
progs_s01_b05l: Lifeline®: expanded states associated with life after physical life and the process of accompanying consciousnesses in transition, described as exploration.
progs_s01_b06l: Timeline®: the relation between consciousness, time and the course of one’s life, through Focus 15.
progs_s01_b07l: Explorare 27®: a week of in-depth exploration of Focus 27, after the prerequisites are met.
progs_s01_b08l: Starlines: the series that continues beyond Focus 27, open as the requirements of each programme are met.
progs_s01_b10l: [SyncCreation®](prog:sync-creation): conscious manifestation, intention and energy, in Focus 11 and 12.
progs_s01_b11l: OBE Spectrum®: a range of states and experiences, from out-of-body experiences to lucid dreaming.
progs_s01_b12l: [Lucid Dreaming®](prog:lucid-dreaming): an intensive on lucid dreaming.
progs_s01_b13l: Explorarea Conștiinței®: the first meeting with the method; the short version is the [workshop](ws:consciousness).
progs_s01_h: Which Monroe programmes exist and what does each explore?
progs_s02_b01p: Start from your question, not from the title. If you want to try the method, listen to the [free exercises](page:exercises). If you want a first contact with guidance, a two-day workshop is easier to fit into a life. If you want depth, Gateway Voyage® is the gate to most of the advanced programmes.
progs_s02_b02p: Each programme’s page states its aims and any prerequisites. If in doubt, write to us with the experience you bring and what you want to explore, and we will help you choose.
progs_s02_h: How do you choose the right programme?
progs_s03_b01p: Participants spend several days in a dedicated setting, away from the usual pace. A day alternates individual audio exercises, explanations and preparation before them, group discussions, meals, breaks, and time for rest and reflection. The exact structure differs from programme to programme and is presented at the start.
progs_s03_b02p: The residential programmes are for people over 18. Alcohol and substances are not permitted during them. Practical details are in the [frequently asked questions](page:faq).
progs_s03_h: How does a residential programme run?
progs_s04_b01p: Workshops are shorter formats, two days or online, easier to try. Each type has a page with its description and past editions, gathered in the [workshop archive](page:archive).
progs_s04_h: What are the workshops, and where do I find the past ones?
progs_seo_desc: All the Monroe Institute® programmes offered in Romania: Gateway Voyage®, SyncCreation®, Lucid Dreaming® and the advanced programmes, with their order and the workshops.

psc_s01_b01p: SyncCreation® is a three-day experiential programme created by the clinical psychologist Dr Joe Gallenberger that uses Hemi-Sync® to work with intention, energy and attention. Its starting idea: to become a “conscious co-creator” of your life, that is, to clarify what you want and to align your actions with that intention.
psc_s02_b01l: Hemi-Sync® exercises in Focus 11 and 12 (see the [Focus levels](page:focus)).
psc_s02_b03l: Aligning conscious thoughts with deeper beliefs, looked at gently.
psc_s02_b04l: Tools you can take up again at home after the programme.
psc_s02_b05p: The programme’s materials also speak of psychokinetic energy. It is a working frame of the programme, which you may explore, not a proven fact, and we promise no results of that kind.
psc_s02_h: What do you explore at SyncCreation®?
psc_s03_b01p: The programme is open to anyone; it does not require a Monroe programme first. It takes place at Plaiul Foii, in Braşov county, with Ritta Nicoară as trainer. The residential programmes are for people over 18.
psc_seo_desc: SyncCreation®: three days of Hemi-Sync® exercises in Focus 11 and 12, on intention, energy and conscious manifestation. No preliminary programme.
psc_seo_title: SyncCreation®: A Three-Day Monroe Programme on Intention
start_h1: How to start with Hemi-Sync®, step by step
start_lead: You need a pair of headphones, half an hour undisturbed, and curiosity. The rest happens in the listening. Here is what you do and what you may feel, from the first day to the seventh.
start_s01_b01l: Stereo headphones. Not speakers: binaural tones need one sound in each ear, see [why](page:technology).
start_s01_b02l: A quiet place where you will not be disturbed: phone on silent, door closed.
start_s01_b03l: Time: plan a full half hour so you are not rushed at the end. The length of each exercise is shown where we know it.
start_s01_b04l: A bed, a sofa or a rug with a cushion: a position in which you can lie down comfortably.
start_s01_b05l: A small notebook, if you like to write down afterwards.
start_s01_h: What do you need to start?
start_s02_b01p: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides, or sit in a chair with your back supported. Cover yourself if you feel cool: the body cools a little as it relaxes. Put on the headphones, set the volume at a comfortable level, then leave it alone.
start_s02_b02p: Close your eyes when the voice tells you to or when you feel like it. You do not need to “do” anything special: follow the voice, breathe, let yourself be settled.
start_s02_b03p: Begin with [Introduction to Hemi-Sync® technology](page:exercises), the best starting exercise for this method.
start_s02_h: How do you settle for your first listen?
start_s03_b01p: As a rule, a voice leads you through three moments: a short preparation (position, breath, an intention), the main part, in which the sound supports the state being explored, and a slow return, which the voice counts. Do not skip the return: it helps you feel whole when you get up.
start_s03_b02p: Along the way, the mind wanders. That is normal. Thoughts do not mean the exercise is not working: in ordinary life you pass quickly from one worry to the next, and now you simply notice what was always there. Do not fight them. Let them pass and return to the voice.
start_s04_b01p: Listeners describe, among other things: heaviness or warmth in the body, a soothing hum in the ears, brief images, a state of calm, more rarely a shiver or an emotion. Many feel nothing remarkable in the first listens, and some fall asleep.
start_s04_b02p: All of this is fine. If you fall asleep you have missed nothing: let it be. If a strong emotion or discomfort appears, you can open your eyes and take off the headphones at any moment.
start_s04_b03k: You have nothing to prove. An exercise is not a test, and “I felt nothing” is as good an account as any.
start_s04_h: What might you feel at first, and what is fine not to feel?
start_s05_b01p: Stay lying a minute with your eyes open. Move your fingers, breathe deeply, stretch. Then, if you like, write down three things: what you noticed, what you felt in the body, what idea stayed with you. That is all. Do not interpret or judge on the same evening.
start_s05_h: What do you do right after an exercise?
start_s06_b01p: There is no obligatory programme. If you want a thread, here is one, to be changed as you feel:
start_s06_b02l: Days 1–2: Introduction to Hemi-Sync® technology, once a day, at the same hour.
start_s06_b03l: Days 3–4: the same exercise, but without expecting anything. Notice what has changed in how you settle.
start_s06_b04l: Day 5: [Forgiveness](page:exercises) or [Spirit of the Season](page:exercises), an exercise with more content.
start_s06_b05l: Days 6–7: read about the [Focus levels](page:focus) and the [article on them](art:nivelurile-focus-pe-intelees), then choose what drew you.
start_s06_h: What does the first week look like?
start_s07_b01p: If you like to carve out a rhythm in a busy day, stay with the exercises and with [Hemi-Sync and meditation](page:meditation). If you want a group setting and guidance, see the [programmes](page:programmes) and the [workshop archive](page:archive). If you have a question you cannot find here, check the [FAQ](page:faq).
start_s07_h: How do you choose after the first week?
start_s08_b01l: Listening on speakers, then concluding that it “does not work”.
start_s08_b02l: Setting the volume too loud so as to hear the tones: it should be lower than you think.
start_s08_b03l: Expecting a spectacular experience and feeling let down by a plain relaxation.
start_s08_b04l: Judging themselves for falling asleep or for thoughts that did not stop.
start_s08_b05l: Listening when rushed or agitated and giving up after two tries.
start_s08_h: What mistakes do many beginners make?
start_seo_desc: What you need, how to settle, what to do and what you may feel on your first Hemi-Sync® listen. A gentle guide for beginners, with free exercises.
start_seo_title: Getting Started with Hemi-Sync®: Your First Listen, Step by Step
tech_lead: A slightly different tone in each ear, and the brain hears a third rhythm. That is what Hemi-Sync® exercises rest on: sound, a voice, and an invitation to quiet.
tech_s01_b01p: Hemi-Sync® (from “Hemispheric Synchronization”) is an audio technology created by Robert Monroe. You listen on headphones, and it uses, among other things, binaural beats: each ear receives a slightly different frequency, and the brain perceives the difference as a third rhythm.
tech_s01_b02p: The Monroe Institute puts it this way: the sound invites the brain to respond; it does not force it. You stay the one who listens, chooses, and can stop at any moment. For the story, read the [history of Hemi-Sync](page:history); for the vocabulary, the [glossary](page:glossary).
tech_s01_b03k: Hemi-Sync® is an exploration and a listening practice. It is not therapy, not a medical device, and not a substitute for treatment.
tech_s02_b01p: The diagram on this page shows the classic example. The left ear receives a 100 Hz tone, the right ear a 104 Hz tone. Each tone on its own is just a low sound, close to a hum.
tech_s02_b02l: Step 1. Two slightly different tones, one for each ear, kept apart by the headphones.
tech_s02_b03l: Step 2. The brain compares the two signals and perceives the difference between them: 4 Hz, four pulses a second. That is the binaural beat.
tech_s02_b04l: Step 3. The idea behind Hemi-Sync® is that the activity of the two hemispheres can tend to follow this rhythm, a kind of agreement between them. Hence “synchronisation”.
tech_s02_b05p: The beat does not exist in the air: it is in neither of the two sounds. It is born in your hearing, which is why it is sometimes called a “phantom sound”. It is heard best with low tones, below roughly 1,000 Hz, and with small differences between them.
tech_s02_h: How does a binaural beat work, step by step?
tech_s03_b01p: Because each ear has to receive its own tone, unmixed. On laptop or phone speakers the two tones combine in the air before they reach you, and the binaural effect does not appear at all. The tones are also low: on small speakers they are barely audible.
tech_s03_b02p: Ordinary stereo headphones, wired or wireless, are enough for the exercises at home. At the residential programmes, wired headphones are used and the organisers supply the rest of the equipment. Keep the volume comfortable, lower than you might think.
tech_s03_h: Why do you need headphones for Hemi-Sync®?
tech_s04_b01p: First a voice, calm and precise, which settles you: the position of the body, the breath, what comes next. Underneath is a background like a slow wave or distant rushing, sometimes music. The binaural tones sit in that background, and you hardly notice them.
tech_s04_b02p: Many listeners describe the body growing heavy and warm, thoughts slowing down, time widening. Others fall asleep. Others feel nothing dramatic and still get up rested. All of these are ordinary responses, and none is the “right answer”.
tech_s04_b03p: If you want to try now, the [free exercises](page:exercises) begin with an introduction to the technology, and the [Getting started](page:start) page walks you through your first listen.
tech_s04_h: What does a Hemi-Sync® exercise sound and feel like?
tech_s05_b01p: Binaural beats have been known since 1839, when the German physicist Heinrich Wilhelm Dove described them. Robert Monroe, a radio and audio producer in the United States, began in the 1950s to study how sound patterns affect states of consciousness. US patent 3,884,218, filed in 1970 and granted on 20 May 1975, carries his name.
tech_s05_b02p: Note what the patent says: its title is “Method of inducing and maintaining various stages of sleep in the human being”. It describes a repeating sound, modulated by a waveform resembling a sleep EEG. It is not the document of the whole technology as it stands today. The full story, including The Monroe Institute, is in the [history of Hemi-Sync](page:history).
tech_s05_b03p: Later, The Monroe Institute also developed Monroe Sound Science (MSS), a wider range of sound techniques built on the same principles.
tech_s05_h: Where does the technology come from, and how old is the idea?
tech_s06_b01p: The binaural beat is a real and well-described auditory phenomenon. Less clear is how much, and in whom, it changes the state of the brain. Studies of binaural beats are small and very different from one another, and their conclusions point in different directions.
tech_s06_b02p: For that reason we do not say here that Hemi-Sync® “works” or that it “heals”. We say what listeners describe and what the method proposes. Any figure or study we cite in future will appear together with its source, opened and checked.
tech_s06_b03p: What you can do is simple and honest: try it, notice, compare it with your own life. A method of direct experience is checked in your own experience.
tech_s06_h: What does the research say, and what do we not know yet?
tech_s07_b01p: If you are in medical or psychological treatment, have an important condition, or are going through a period that is shaking you, talk first with your doctor or psychologist. The programmes are educational and experiential, not a treatment, and medication is never changed for them.
tech_s07_b02p: If you or someone close to you is in immediate danger, call 112.
tech_s07_h: Who should talk to someone before choosing Hemi-Sync®?

tech_seo_title: How Hemi-Sync® Works: Binaural Audio, Plainly Explained
wadv_lead: The continuation of the Consciousness Exploration workshop: more practice, Human Plus® tools and work with intention, in Focus 10, 11 and 12.
wadv_s01_b01p: It is a series of Monroe workshops that continues [Consciousness Exploration](ws:consciousness). Having taken that workshop is a prerequisite. Module 1, “Personal Development”, is practical: you learn mental and energetic tools that you can revisit afterwards, on your own.
wadv_s02_b01l: Focus 10: you review the basic tools as a foundation.
wadv_s02_b02l: Focus 11, the “access channel”: you become familiar with Human Plus® (H-Plus®), exercises in which you formulate an intention and learn “function commands” you can revisit in everyday life.
wadv_s02_b03l: Focus 12: guided exercises with symbolism, for emotional reflection and integration.
wadv_s02_b04p: Results differ from person to person, and the workshop’s own description says so: after the workshop, the practice is yours.
wadv_s02_h: What do you explore in the “Personal Development” module?
wadv_s03_b01p: It is the second module of the series, with module I as a prerequisite. The old page describes it as a Monroe programme with exercises for entering the heart space, for sleep and regeneration, and with audio signals developed within the Institute. It is not therapy and does not replace medical care.
wadv_seo_desc: Advanced Excursion, the Personal Development module: Focus 10, Focus 11 (Human Plus®) and Focus 12. Prerequisites, structure and what you explore, in Romanian.
wadv_seo_title: Advanced Excursion: A Monroe Workshop with Focus 10, 11, 12
wcon_lead: Three days for two: Hemi-Sync® meditations done with a life partner, with two intentions, one personal and one shared.
wcon_s01_b01p: The old page described it as a three-day workshop for deep connection between partners. It has two aims: one personal (balance and self-knowledge), one for the relationship (drawing close to the partner, listening, affirming your individuality).
wcon_s01_b02p: The workshop is not couple therapy. If the relationship is in crisis, a couple therapist is more suitable.
wcon_s01_h: What is the Deep Connection workshop?
wcon_s02_b01p: The old description speaks of meditations done as a pair, in which each follows their own experience. In Monroe programmes, even if you come together, you go through the exercises individually, without constantly comparing what each feels, and then talk about them. We have no editions recorded now; the calendar will announce them.
wcon_seo_desc: Deep Connection, a three-day workshop for two partners, with Hemi-Sync® meditations on listening and connection. Description and edition status.
wcon_seo_title: Deep Connection: A Hemi-Sync® Workshop for Partners, 3 Days
wcons_lead: Your first encounter with the Monroe method, in two days: Hemi-Sync® exercises on headphones, in a small group, guided in Romanian. The old pages also called it “Excursion”.
wcons_s01_b01p: It is a two-day experiential workshop built on Hemi-Sync® exercises. On the old pages it appears as “Excursie” (in English, “Excursion”), and it is the starting workshop of the Monroe method, from which one continues to [Advanced Excursion](ws:advanced).
wcons_s01_b02p: The old pages speak of 10 audio exercises listened to across the two days, and of small groups of 8–12 people. The organisers provide headphones and mats.
wcons_s01_h: What is the Consciousness Exploration workshop?
wcons_s02_b01l: Day 1: you learn to enter and stay in Focus 10, “mind awake, body asleep”, and to return to waking.
wcons_s02_b02l: Day 2: you explore Focus 12, expanded awareness, with exercises of intention and inner exploration.
wcons_s02_b03l: After each exercise: an integration pause, notes and, if you wish, a group conversation.
wcons_s02_b04p: A stated aim of the workshop is that, in time, you can revisit these states without the sound. What you actually feel is individual; see the [Focus levels](page:focus).
wcons_s02_h: What do you do over the two days?
wcons_s03_b01p: People curious about self-knowledge, meditators and those in a period of searching. You need no prior experience. If you have a condition or are in treatment, tell us before registering and talk with your doctor or psychologist.
wcons_s03_b02k: The descriptions are accounts of participants’ experience and of the Monroe programmes, not statements about reality or promises of results.
wcons_s04_b01p: The workshop is a short version, to taste the method. [Gateway Voyage®](prog:gateway-voyage) is the six-day residential programme, more in depth. The programme calendar may also list a residential edition of Explorarea Conștiinței®.
wcons_s04_h: How does it relate to Gateway Voyage®?
wcons_seo_desc: A two-day Monroe workshop with Hemi-Sync® exercises: your first encounter with Focus 10 and Focus 12, in Romanian. What you do, what you feel, the editions archive.
wcons_seo_title: Consciousness Exploration Workshop: Focus 10 and 12, 2 Days
wcre_lead: A two-day workshop on creativity, as the old page described it, with Hemi-Sync® exercises built around exploring the imagination.
wcre_s01_b01p: The old page describes it as a two-day workshop in which participants discover their creative side through structured exercises. Its central idea: exploring creativity is one of the most fulfilling activities and can bring us closer to ourselves.
wcre_s01_b02p: The description on the old page was aimed at children. We have no editions recorded and announce no dates until the right setting is settled (participants’ age, an adult present, parents’ consent).
wcre_s01_h: What is the Creative Life workshop?
wcre_s02_b01p: The exercises rest on Hemi-Sync® technology, which you can get to know better on the [Technology](page:technology) page. For adults, a suitable starting point is [Consciousness Exploration](ws:consciousness).
wcre_s02_h: How does it relate to the Monroe method?
wcre_seo_desc: Creative Life, a two-day workshop on creativity with Hemi-Sync® exercises. What the old Psizone page said and what we know now about editions.
wcre_seo_title: Creative Life: A Hemi-Sync® Workshop on Creativity, 2 Days
wobe_h1: Out of Body workshop: exploring the out-of-body experience
wobe_lead: A workshop that treats the out-of-body experience as an experience to explore: how it is prepared, how clarity is kept and how you return, with no guarantee of outcome.
wobe_s01_b01p: An experience in which a person describes perceiving themselves apart from the physical body, often with sensations of floating, expansion or observing from a distance. Many people report it as a spontaneous experience, in sleep or in states of deep relaxation. What it means, as reality, remains an open question.
wobe_s02_b01l: Preparation: visualisation, anchoring, a clear intention.
wobe_s02_b02l: The stages and sensations usually described in such experiences.
wobe_s02_b04l: Working with fear and mental blocks, with an integration journal.
wobe_s02_b05p: The exercises use Hemi-Sync® at the Focus 10, 12 and 21 levels, described on the [Focus levels](page:focus) page.
wobe_s02_h: What is worked on in the workshop?

wonl_lead: From home, on headphones: the online Consciousness Exploration workshop, the “Calea Hemi-Sync” webinar and a pack of seven guided meditations.
wonl_s01_b01p: A two-day, live, 100% online workshop held on 7–8 June 2025. The programme used Hemi-Sync® technology and explored Focus 10 and Focus 12 through 10 guided audio exercises, with pauses for reflection, notes and sharing.
wonl_s01_b02p: In the online version you need headphones, a stable connection and a place where you can lie undisturbed. The rest is done as in the in-person workshop: [Consciousness Exploration](ws:consciousness).
wonl_s01_h: What was the online Consciousness Exploration workshop?
wonl_s02_b01p: An introductory webinar on the Hemi-Sync® method and on the Monroe Institute workshops. We have no date recorded; it appears in the programme calendar when announced.
wonl_s03_b01p: A pack of seven guided meditations, each supported by its own binaural frequencies, for relaxation and quieting thoughts, with headphones recommended. It was an offer on the old Psizone page; we do not carry it over here until the audio licence is confirmed.

wopt_s01_b01p: A two-day experiential workshop built on Hemi-Sync® audio exercises and guided in Romanian. Participants learn about the technology, The Monroe Institute and Robert Monroe, then listen to the exercises, followed by discussion.
wopt_s01_h: What is the Optimise Your Life workshop?

wopt_s02_b06l: The meeting with “personal guides”, an image from the Monroe method, read as inner exploration.
wopt_s02_b07l: Recalling the past and regaining personal energy, as an exercise in reflection.

wopt_s02_h: What do the eight exercises contain?
wopt_s03_b01p: Anyone who wants a first meeting with the method in a short format: people in transitions, professionals looking for a pause, or the curious about self-knowledge. We promise no results; we describe what is done.

ws_register_h: How do you register for the next edition?
ws_register_p: Future editions appear in the [programme calendar](page:programmes). Registering sends a request, not a booking. Until an edition appears, you can start with the [free exercises](page:exercises).
wsfaq_g01_a01: Not for the starting workshops such as [Consciousness Exploration](ws:consciousness). The advanced ones have prerequisites, stated for each.
wsfaq_g01_a02: No. The Monroe method asks for no doctrine and promises no particular result. It asks only for the curiosity to explore and to draw your own conclusions.
wsfaq_g01_a03: Yes, that is fine. Do not force wakefulness. If the body needs sleep, let it, without pressure and without feeling you have missed something.
